title: fast fashion giant shein set open flat hong kong market debut 2026 09 01
text:
HONG KONG, Sept 1 (Reuters) - Shares in fast fashion giant Shein (0625.HK)
, opens new tab
 were ​set open flat in their ‌Hong Kong market debut on Tuesday, hurt by numerous setbacks that have ​long delayed its listing ​and undermined the foundations of its ⁠business.
Known globally for selling $5 tops ​and $10 dresses, Shein has been ​humbled by tariff and duty changes in the U.S. and Europe.
In 2022, it ​was one of the world's ​most valuable startups worth an estimated $100 billion ‌but ⁠last week's IPO valued the company at about $26.5 billion. Shein also failed to list in ​New York ​and London, ⁠hampered by intense scrutiny of its business practices ​in the West and ​blocked ⁠by Chinese authorities.
